one_line: Open on the child's photo beside the book it stars in, with the promise said and written together.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 static top-down: two illustrated books on a red toy table, two small round baby photos below. Headline box at the top; voice at once (transcript): "תמונה אחת שלהם והם הופכים לכוכבי הסיפור". First cut 0:03.
q1_hook.why: The promise is said and written together from 0:00 (H6, T3), and a viewer knows by 2.5 s what the book gives (H2). The frame already shows the proof, real photos beside the books they star in (S2, H1). It stays static for 3 s, so movement only starts at 0:03 (E1).

beats.what: Static top-down: two books on a red toy table, two baby photo cards below; headline text box
beats.why: Proof and promise in the first frame

beats.what: Top-down hands on a page after a white flash; "תמיד אלה סיפורים על דמויות דמיוניות"
Toddler at eye level points at a picture; "אבל הפעם- הסיפור הוא עליהם"
beats.why: The turn arrives with a real child's reaction

beats.what: A toddler's hand on the cover, top-down; "בזכות MeBook הם פוגשים את עצמם בתוך הסיפור"
beats.why: Brand named while a child touches the book

beats.what: Baby crawls to a book; toddler holds a book up; "שלא ציפיתי לתגובה כזאת.."
beats.why: Two child reactions and the parent's honest admission

beats.what: Illustrated baby on a cover dissolves into a real baby crawling; "גם הילדים שלכם יכולים להיות הגיבורים"
beats.why: Visual payoff of the opening promise

beats.what: "אז למה אתם מחכים??"; toddler on a bed with a book; pill "קוד קופון מחכה לכם בתיאור"
beats.why: Pointer to the code in the last seconds

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: In the video, only a pointer to the code. Caption: a topic question, "איזה נושא הילדים שלכם היו בוחרים לסיפור שלהם?", and a save ask, "שמרו את הפוסט למתנה הבאה לילדים".
q2_flow.why: A new picture every 2 to 4 s with real toddlers keeps it moving (R3, K8). The line runs from "always imaginary characters" to "this time it is about them" to "I did not expect this reaction" (K2). The dissolve at 0:19 lands near the end (R4), with no dead tail (R1).

q3_cta.what: Spoken (transcript) at about 0:23 and written at 0:24: "קוד קופון מחכה לכם בתיאור" in a dark pill with gift and pointing-down emojis. Caption: a 10% code, a topic question and a save ask.
q3_cta.why: Said and shown after the benefit, pointing to the caption (C6), but the pill sits in the bottom band. The caption adds a question and a save ask beside the code (C1). The question is open and specific (C5); the save has a reason but no named person (C4).

q4_shown.what: Two books beside two real baby photo cards with name labels, 0:00-0:03; a toddler's hand on pages and covers 0:04-0:11; babies with the book 0:12-0:19; an illustrated baby dissolving into a real baby 0:19-0:21; a toddler reading on a bed. No price, no screen recording.
q4_shown.why: A photo beside the illustrated cover, held steady for 3 s, is the likeness proof a buyer needs (S2), but the name labels are small. Several toddlers react (S6), though the personalising step is only said, not shown (S8). Baby photos beside names go against S5.

q5_edit.what: About 8 scenes in 25.6 s, about 3 s each; the detector found only 4 cuts, as most joins are dissolves or a white flash. No speed changes seen. A new text box every 2 to 5 s. Ends on the pill.
q5_edit.why: Soft joins suit the tender mood, but eight different children or settings in 25 s are fast, unrelated changes (E2). Text boxes follow the voice (E4). The first change comes at 0:03 (E1), and it ends on the CTA with no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: Children seeing themselves as the hero of a book: toddlers react to personalised books, with a 10% code. It serves a parent shopping for a treat or gift.
q6_topic.why: Toddler faces and reactions carry the feeling (K8), tender and sweet, not a peak (K1). "שמרו את הפוסט למתנה הבאה" ties it to a next gift (K7). A gift or treat idea is easy to send on (R5).

q7_filmed.what: A static top-down tabletop set of books and photo cards; handheld top-down hands on pages; eye-level toddlers; a floor-level baby crawling; a wide bed shot. Home daylight and lamp light. Several toddlers; the adult shows only hands and a knee.
q7_filmed.why: Real home clips look native (H8, F7). Top-down hands put the viewer in the reader's seat (F5). In the first frame the books and cards fill the frame, but the name labels are too small to read at phone size (F4). Many faces carry the emotion (K8).

q8_text.on_screen: Translucent white rounded box, dark text, 2 to 4 short lines, emojis, changing every 2 to 5 s: "תמונה אחת שלהם והם הופכים לכוכבי הסיפור" (0:00, top), "תמיד אלה סיפורים על דמויות דמיוניות שהם גם ככה לא יכירו" (0:04), "אבל הפעם- הסיפור הוא עליהם" (0:07), "בשבילם זה רגע של שמחה בשבילי? עולם ומלואו" (0:12), "אז למה אתם מחכים??" (0:22), dark pill "קוד קופון מחכה לכם בתיאור" (0:24, bottom).
q8_text.caption: "ספר שבו הילד שלכם הוא הגיבור של הסיפור". About 60 words in short paragraphs: how easy it is, a topic question, a save ask, a 10% code, "בשיתוף- @mebook.ai", then 5 hashtags.
q8_text.why: A first-frame headline, and boxes carrying the whole voice, work muted (T3, T1). But they are full sentences over the picture, the first box at the top edge and the pill at the bottom (T2, T4). The caption has parent search words and 5 hashtags (T7); the partnership is near its end (T8).

weak_points: Full-sentence boxes over pages and children; many different toddlers and no page-by-page look at the story; the CTA pill in the bottom band; three asks in the caption; baby photos beside names.
lumebook_takeaway: Top-down on a table: the source photo (no child's face) beside the book cover, held 3 s with the promise line; then two page close-ups and the offer in writing.
not_verified: Whether the voice is the creator's or the children are hers; whether music plays. The transcript is partial, so burned-in text is quoted. The 8 scenes are from the frames, not the detector. Whether the illustrated baby at 0:19 is the baby who crawls at 0:20 is implied only. The photo cards carry names, not quoted. The caption's first line ends in a dash, not quoted.
